name: Atomic Depth-Color Packing for Point Clouds
aliases: Basic Compute Shader Point Cloud Rendering
definition: A method that resolves visibility and color simultaneously by encoding depth and color into a single 64-bit integer and using 64-bit atomicMin to select the point with the lowest depth for each pixel.
summary: Atomic Depth-Color Packing renders point clouds by encoding depth and color into a single 64-bit integer, using atomicMin to resolve visibility and color simultaneously in one pass.
